description:
List available TTS voices (id, label, preview audio URL) for a provider:
    "minimax" (default engine) or "elevenlabs". Match the project's
    voice_tts_provider (see get_project) so picked ids work with its engine.
    Returns {groups: {name: count}, voices}; the ElevenLabs catalogue is
    150+ voices, so pass group (names from `groups`) rather than reading it
    all at once.

group.description: Return only this catalogue group (case-insensitive; e.g. "Narration", "Characters"). Empty returns every group — the ElevenLabs catalogue is 150+ voices, so filter it by group; the response's `groups` lists the valid names with counts.
group.title: Group

provider.description: TTS engine to list voices for: "minimax" (default engine) or "elevenlabs"; match the project's voice_tts_provider
provider.title: Provider

name: list_voices
title: List voices
